title: Tasty Treats
description: Tasty Treats adds four simple craftable foods, a bacon sandwich, toffee apple, chocolate cake slice, and honey bun made from every day ingredients.
body:
# 🍴 Tasty Treats ### *Simple, craftable comfort food for Fabric & NeoForge* ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11-62B47A?style=flat-square) ![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-supported-DBD0B4?style=flat-square) ![NeoForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/NeoForge-supported-F16436?style=flat-square)
--- Hungry for something better than a plain steak? **Tasty Treats** adds a handful of simple, satisfying foods you can craft from ingredients you already have lying around your base — **no new ores, no grind, no machines.** Just better lunches. Every recipe is **shapeless** and uses vanilla ingredients, so it drops straight into survival without changing how you play — and a couple of treats come with a little kick. Built on Minecraft's modern data-component food system. ## 🍽️ What's on the Menu > 🥓 **Bacon Sandwich** — the hearty hunger-filler for a hard day down the mineshaft, and the most filling food in the pack. > > 🍬 **Toffee Apple** — sweet, quick, and serves up a short burst of **Speed I** to run it off. > > 🍫 **Chocolate Cake Slice** — a rich little pick-me-up, without having to place down the whole cake. > > 🍯 **Honey Bun** — soft, sweet, and carries a gentle touch of **Regeneration I**. ## 📋 Recipes & Stats All recipes are **shapeless** — just drop the ingredients anywhere in the crafting grid: | Food | Recipe | 🍗 Hunger | ✨ Saturation | ⏱️ Effect | |:-----|:-------|:--------:|:------------:|:----------| | 🥓 **Bacon Sandwich** | Cooked Porkchop + Bread | 8 | 0.8 | — | | 🍬 **Toffee Apple** | Apple + Sugar | 6 | 0.6 | Speed I (5s) | | 🍫 **Chocolate Cake Slice** | Cake + Cocoa Beans | 5 | 0.6 | — | | 🍯 **Honey Bun** | Wheat + Honey Bottle | 4 | 0.5 | Regeneration I (5s) | *Hunger is measured in nutrition points — a full hunger bar is 20.* ## ⚙️ Installation Works on **both Fabric and NeoForge** for **Minecraft 1.21.11**. Install on **both the client and the server** — the server handles the items and recipes, the client renders them. > ⚠️ **Required dependencies — the mod won't load without these:** > - **[Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api)** — *both loaders* > - **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)** — *Fabric only* ## 💬 Feedback & Suggestions Spotted a bug, or got a snack you'd love to see added? Leave a comment or open an issue — recipe ideas are always welcome!
*Dig in.* 🍴
